# UrbanBreathe
> Air-quality decision-support prototype for Indian cities. It applies the CPCB National AQI method to modelled CAMS data (via Open-Meteo) and labels every value with its data basis. Built for the ET AI Hackathon 2.0 prototype.

## Core Features
- [Current Conditions](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): NAQI-method estimate from modelled CAMS data (not an official CPCB station AQI), hourly PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, O₃, SO₂, CO in µg/m³, and modelled weather
- [Source Context](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): Descriptive indicators only — no source apportionment
- [Model Forecast](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): 72-hour CAMS model forecast with NAQI-method estimates; not evaluated against observations
- [Scenario Explorer](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): Illustrative arithmetic with uncited placeholder reductions; no health or cost estimates
- [Executive Brief](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): Printable situation summary with data basis and limitations
- [Citizen Advisory](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/): CPCB health statements and general precautions (English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu)

## API Reference
- GET /api/cities — List supported cities
- GET /api/air-quality/:cityId — Current NAQI-method estimate, hourly concentrations and modelled weather
- GET /api/sources/:cityId — Source context indicators (no apportionment)
- GET /api/forecast/:cityId — 72-hour model forecast
- GET /api/simulation/interventions — Intervention catalogue with placeholder assumptions
- POST /api/simulation/run — Illustrative scenario
- POST /api/brief/generate — Situation brief
- GET /api/advisory/:cityId?lang=en|hi|bn|te — Citizen advisory
- GET /api/health — Server health check

## Data
- [Open-Meteo Air Quality API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/air-quality-api): CAMS global model output (CC BY 4.0, free for non-commercial use)
- Demo fixtures: illustrative values used only when the server runs with DATA_MODE=demo, always labelled DEMO
- Method: CPCB National Air Quality Index (CUPS/82/2014-15); see docs/methodology/naqi.md

## Technology
- React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 3.4, Express.js, Recharts, Lucide Icons
